title: Cooperation Through Indirect Reciprocity in Child-Robot Interactions
reasoning: The paper investigates prosociality and cooperation in child-robot interactions using social dilemmas (Stag Hunt game) and multi-armed bandit algorithms. While it discusses moral judgments and reputation-based cooperation, it is primarily a study of Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) and behavioral game theory rather than a benchmark or evaluation of religious, faith-based, or ethical reasoning systems.
